title: nixos/snapserver: migrate options per snapcast 0.33 changes
reason: Real RFC42-style restructuring: settings.stream.{bind_to_address,port,sampleformat,codec,chunk_ms,buffer} renamed into a new settings.tcp-streaming.* group and settings.tcp.* renamed to settings.tcp-control.* (all via mkRenamedOptionModule shims); settings.stream.source stays in place (not renamed) but is relocated within the file and its description typo ('inpuit'->'input') is fixed.
targets_toml: Self-corrected: first attempt watched 'tcp-streaming.source' (0 discovered, wrong -- misread the diff; source was never moved to tcp-streaming, only bind_to_address/port/etc were). Corrected to watch=['stream.source'] under option_prefix=[services,snapserver,settings], which found 14 discovered_options.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Real, unchanged option: 'stream.source' was never renamed (unlike its former siblings), just relocated in the file and description-fixed. Correctly PredicateNotFound both sides (real predicate exists, but the snapcast test never sets it to a literal). Renders correctly as 'Unchanged: 1' -- not a rendering gap.
